epics.title: Convert and verify the synthetic order-pricing program

stories.title: Validate the order (line count, tier, zero quantity)
tasks: Generate DEMOORD1 with the local converter
Run scenarios F07, F08, F09, F10, F11 and F12
acceptance_criteria: Return codes 8, 4 and 12 are set exactly as specified, with all amounts 0
The line-count check precedes the tier check

stories.title: Price the lines and apply the tier discount
tasks: Run scenarios F02, F03, F04, F13, F14 and F16
acceptance_criteria: Subtotal is the sum over the first LINE-COUNT lines
Discounts match the thresholds, with fractions truncated
The maximum order is calculated without truncation

stories.title: Shipping, total and per-call reset
tasks: Run scenarios F01, F05, F06 and F15
acceptance_criteria: Shipping is 695 below a net of 7500 and 0 from 7500
Values preset by the caller never appear in the result

stories.title: Independent verification and review
tasks: Compare the Java with the independent oracle on boundary, negative and seeded cases (G6)
acceptance_criteria: The review has no blocking finding
